en.title: Angular SEO & Prerendering Developer | Kerllos Ayad
en.description: Make an Angular app readable by search engines and AI assistants: prerendered pages, unique meta tags and structured data.
en.summary: Prerendered Angular pages with their own titles, canonical URLs and structured data, so crawlers can read them.
en.whatYouGet: Angular pages that search engines and AI assistants can read. A client-side Angular application sends crawlers an empty shell, so its content is invisible to anything that does not run JavaScript. Prerendering generates the full HTML of each route at build time, with its own title, description, canonical URL and headings. I set this up with Angular SSR and add structured data, a sitemap and a real 404 page. This site is built this way: every page is prerendered.
included: Angular SSR with every route prerendered to its own HTML
A unique title, description and canonical URL on every page
One H1 and a logical heading outline per page
JSON-LD structured data such as Service, FAQPage and BreadcrumbList
A sitemap, robots.txt and llms.txt
A real 404 page for unknown URLs
Browser-only code fixed so the server build works, such as window, document and localStorage
A bilingual setup with RTL and hreflang, as built for this site
en.pricing: The price depends on the number of routes, whether the application already uses server rendering, how much browser-only code has to be fixed and which structured data you need. Adding prerendering to a small site is a different job from converting a large application. Defined work is usually quoted at a fixed price. Send me the address of your application and I will reply with what I would check first and an estimate.

عنوان ووصف ورابط canonical فريد لكل صفحة
عنوان H1 واحد وبنية عناوين داخلية منطقية لكل صفحة

خريطة موقع وملفا robots.txt وllms.txt

إعداد ثنائي اللغة مع RTL وhreflang، كما بُني لهذا الموقع
ar.pricing: يعتمد السعر على عدد المسارات وهل يستخدم التطبيق العرض على الخادم بالفعل ومقدار الكود الذي يعمل في المتصفح فقط ويحتاج إصلاحًا والبيانات المنظمة التي تحتاجها. إضافة التوليد المسبق لموقع صغير عمل مختلف عن تحويل تطبيق كبير. غالبًا يكون العمل المحدد بسعر ثابت. أرسل لي عنوان تطبيقك وسأرد عليك بما سأفحصه أولًا وبتقدير للتكلفة.
